The '''M.P Birla Group''' is an Indian industrial group named after [[Madhav Prasad Birla]]. It has business interests in cement, cables, jute goods and guar gum.

== Operations ==
It has a registered office in [[Kolkata]] and regional offices in Mumbai and New Delhi, among other places. In addition to Kolkata, [[Birlapur]] and [[Durgapur]], the group has plants located in [[Rewa, Madhya Pradesh|Rewa]], [[Maihar]], [[Satna]], [[Raebareli|Raebareli City]], [[Raebareli|Kundanganj (Raebareli)]], Chanderia (Chittorgarh), [[Jodhpur]], [[Viramgam]], [[Bhiwani]], [[Butibori]] and [[Goa]].

*[[Birla Corporation]] is the flagship company of the group.

==Philanthropy==

The M. P. Birla Group is known for its philanthropic and educational activities, and supports many hospitals, schools, and technical and management institutions.

Some of the educational institutions and hospitals run by the group include: 
*[[Birla Planetarium, Kolkata|M. P. Birla Planetarium, Kolkata]]
*M. P. Birla Institute of Management, Bengaluru
*[[M. P. Birla Foundation Higher Secondary School|M. P. Birla Foundation Higher Secondary School, Kolkata]]

Notable trusts and societies under ''M.P. Birla Group'' are [[Hindustan Medical Institution]], [[Eastern India Educational Institution]], and [[South Point School|South Point Foundation]].
